action.intent: Select Lokum from the unit list and inspect labor preferences.
Open Lokum's farming labor options to assign brewing.
Select the dwarf north of the cat and inspect labor preferences.
Open Lokum's farming labor group to assign a brewer.
Enable Lokum's farming, brewing, and plant gathering labors.
Leave labor settings after confirming farming, brewing, and plant gathering are enabled.
Designate an entrance stair near camp, then inspect the level below for shelter excavation.
Designate the lower stair and excavate a connected room for beds and farming.
Allow the miner and carpenter time to finish the chamber and storage barrels.
Open farm plot placement in the excavated soil chamber.
Position a 3×3 farm plot on cleared underground soil.
Place the valid 3×3 underground farm and let construction proceed.
Inspect the new underground farm plot and choose its crops.
Select plump helmets for all seasons.
Select plump helmets and apply the crop to all seasons.
Create an underground food stockpile beside the plump helmet farm and let queued work proceed.
Begin placing beds in the excavated chamber.
Place the first bed in the excavated sleeping area.
Place the first bed and allow construction and farming to proceed.
Inspect the placed bed and its room settings.
Define a shared sleeping room from the completed bed.
Expand the bedroom area and confirm it, then enable its dormitory setting.
Place another bed in the confirmed dormitory.
Place the second dormitory bed and select the next bed location.
Place the third dormitory bed and select the fourth bed's material.
Place the remaining four beds and allow construction and barrel production to proceed.
Inspect the surface still and restore brewing now that the beds are installed.
Move the building cursor onto the still to inspect brewing jobs.
Open the still's task menu to queue brewing.
Queue repeating brewing and allow dwarves to work.
Check current food, drink, and fortress status after brewing work.
Return to the fortress and let farming, brewing, and hauling progress; drink reserves have increased to about 80.
Inspect the carpenter to replenish empty barrels after brewing stopped.
Open carpenter tasks to order barrels for brewing.
Queue six wooden barrels to enable brewing and let the carpenter work.
Inspect the still and restart brewing after barrel production.
Open the still's task menu to restart brewing.
Resume repeat brewing and allow workshop production.
Check food and drink reserves after restarting brewing.
Return to the fortress and let crops grow while queued work proceeds.
Resume the fortress so farming, brewing, fishing, and hauling can continue.
Inspect workshop selection to begin producing dining furniture.
Select the carpenter and inspect available furniture jobs.
Queue three tables and three chairs for a dining area, then let dwarves work.
Open table placement underground to furnish the dining area.
Place the first dining table in the underground hall.
Place the available table and select an adjacent chair for the dining area.
Allow carpentry and table installation to finish before furnishing the dining area.
Place a chair beside the dining table.
Resume time so the carpenter can finish queued chairs and tables.
Select the completed table and inspect its dining-room options.
Define a dining room from the completed table.
Expand the dining room around the table and confirm it.
Enable the communal meeting hall and let farming and furniture production proceed.
Check whether a chair is ready to install beside the dining table.
Place a chair next to the dining table.
Select the willow chair, leave construction menus, and allow fortress work to proceed.
Let farming, fishing, and workshop work continue; the dining chair is now visible in place.
Let crops grow and the fortress continue operating.
Let crops grow and fortress work proceed.
Let farming, fishing, and hauling continue toward the next season.
Check food, drink, and fortress status as spring progresses.
Return to the fortress and inspect the surface still to resume brewing harvested crops.
Select the still and inspect its brewing queue.
